purpose: Cover AC-15801-1 (library.json:issues object snapshotted onto rcf/blueprint-libraries.json:entries[] as issuesRepo and issuesVisibility on rcf library add; the review-on-add card prints the Feedback destination line naming repo and visibility), AC-15801-2 (destination.resolve walks entry -> manifest -> registry issuesRepo, falls back to sourceRef derivation for github URLs with derived:true, returns unresolved when neither is available; shelf and core route to Stravica/rcf-lite) and AC-15801-3 (rcf doctor --check feedback-destinations lists every registered library with no resolvable destination as a warn-only row with refusedByFix:true; exit stays 0).
title: Slice 3 (FBS-182): library.json issues field snapshotted on library add, destination resolver walks the manifest/registry chain, and rcf doctor feedback-destinations warns on libraries with no resolvable destination

testCases.description: Cover AC-15801-1 via the CLI test: a library.json with an issues object of { repo, visibility: 'private' } is added to a fresh project; rcf/blueprint-libraries.json carries issuesRepo and issuesVisibility on the entry, the review-on-add stdout matches 'Feedback destination: OWNER/REPO (private)', and a second library without an issues field neither prints the line nor writes the fields on the registry entry.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/feedback-destinations.test.js::AC-15801-1: library.json issues is snapshotted onto the registry entry and the review card prints the Feedback destination line

testCases.description: Cover AC-15801-2 via the unit test: destination.resolve returns the expected shape for each of the four fixture cases from the AC given: a shelf blueprint routes to CORE_REPO with derived:false; a library entry with explicit issues wins over derivation and reports source: library-manifest; a library entry with no issues but a github git+https sourceRef derives OWNER/REPO with derived:true and source: sourceRef-derivation; a library entry with neither issues nor a github source returns unresolved with reason no-github-source; a library entry that is completely absent returns unresolved with reason unknown-target.
testCases.testPointer: test/feedback/destination.test.js::AC-15801-2 shelf fixture: a blueprint with no libraryPrefix routes to CORE_REPO

testCases.description: Cover AC-15801-3 via the CLI test: rcf doctor --check feedback-destinations --json against a project with two registered libraries (one with issues, one without) returns exactly one drift row of item unresolved-library naming the second library, whose message includes the publisher.contact from the registry entry and whose refusedByFix flag is true; the overall doctor exit code stays 0 because the check is warn-only.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/feedback-destinations.test.js::AC-15801-3: rcf doctor --check feedback-destinations warns on a library without a resolvable destination and exits 0

testCases.description: Cover AC-15801-4 (single-library slug match) via the unit test: a bare-slug manifest record (no libraryPrefix) for 'application-spa' plus exactly one registered library ('wsd') that owns 'application-spa' and declares issuesRepo resolves to that library's declared destination with source 'library-slug-inference', derived false, kind library.
testCases.testPointer: test/feedback/destination.test.js::AC-15801-4 library-slug-inference: bare-slug apply routes to the single library owning the slug when it declares issuesRepo

testCases.description: Cover AC-15801-4 (multi-library slug ambiguity) via the unit test: a bare-slug manifest record for 'application-spa' plus two registered libraries ('wsd' and 'ally') that both own 'application-spa' and both declare issuesRepo resolves to unresolved, reason 'ambiguous-library-slug', with candidates ['ally','wsd'] (sorted).
testCases.testPointer: test/feedback/destination.test.js::AC-15801-4 library-slug-inference: two libraries owning the same slug return unresolved with reason ambiguous-library-slug

testCases.description: Cover AC-15801-4 (no-library fall-through) via the unit test: a bare-slug manifest record for 'security-auth-magic-link' plus registered libraries that do NOT own the slug falls through to the shelf constant unchanged from AC-15801-2.
testCases.testPointer: test/feedback/destination.test.js::AC-15801-4 library-slug-inference: no library owns the slug -> shelf constant fall-through
